info.title: MS Realty application transport
info.description: Generated from src/server/transport/registry.ts by scripts/openapi.mjs; do not edit. Application endpoints only (architecture §19.3), never raw collections. Mutations follow the §5.1 envelope: server-derived Principal, logical operation identity, expected revision where applicable, and one of the §5.1 results.

put.summary: Upload and seal scoped staging bytes
put.description: Requires x-upload-token for the expiring upload slot, current session and exact same-origin. Repeated bytes reconcile to the same sealed object; different bytes conflict. Raw media maximum 25 MB, documents 20 MB. Scanning is queued, never implied by acceptance.

get.summary: Release readiness for the running build
get.description: Release identity and the R00–R12 gate summary from the readiness snapshot evaluated for this exact build/environment/manifest/policy. A missing, expired, unbound or invalid snapshot reports every gate blocked. No secret, evidence content or personal data is returned.

get.summary: Issue a logical submission key for an inquiry form
get.description: Returns a server-issued key (256 random bits plus a MAC) and makes sure the browser holds a receipt-session cookie.

set-cookie.description: Receipt-session cookie, when the browser has none

post.description: One logical submission per key: the same key and payload return the same receipt (200), another payload under the key is refused. JSON clients get the receipt; a form post is answered 303 to the receipt page, or back to the form with only the key and error code.

comparisonReferences.description: Navigation only: 1–3 comma-separated canonical unique ordered listing references, including the individual inquiry subject

selectedListings.description: JSON array of 1–3 ordered unique reference/observedManifestId pairs; mutually exclusive with listingReference

200.description: A retry of an accepted submission: the original receipt (JSON)

303.description: Form post: to the receipt page, or back to the form with the error code

post.summary: Verify and record a Resend delivery event
post.description: Verify the exact raw UTF-8 body using the account's Svix webhook secret and svix-id, svix-timestamp and svix-signature headers. Deduplicate the signed event, persist only delivery identifiers, and reconcile the external-action ledger. Inbound email never grants identity or Case access. 128 KiB body limit.

x-authorization-classes.receipt_session: An anonymous visitor holding the receipt-session cookie that made the submission.
x-authorization-classes.client_session: A signed-in client on the client host; record and field audience checks apply per record.
x-authorization-classes.staff_session: A signed-in staff member with an active membership on the staff host, holding the named capability.
x-authorization-classes.private_session: A current client or staff session on its own private host, with per-record authorization and audience checks.
x-authorization-classes.provider_signature: A provider webhook whose signature and account are verified.
